description: This file implements a Speech-to-Text (STT) service class using Sarvam AI's SDK, supporting real-time transcription with WebSocket streaming, voice activity detection (VAD), and language configuration. It includes methods for starting/stopping the service, handling WebSocket communication, and processing incoming transcription data and events.

classes.name: SarvamSTTService
classes.description: A service class for Sarvam AI speech-to-text processing, supporting real-time WebSocket streaming, configuration of language, prompt, VAD, and handling of transcription results and events.

classes.name: InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the SarvamSTTService, including language, prompt, VAD signals, and VAD sensitivity.

methods.description: Initializes the SarvamSTTService with API key, model, sample rate, audio codec, and configuration parameters.

methods.description: Converts a pipecat Language enum to Sarvam's language code.

methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: set_language(self, language: Language)
methods.description: Sets the recognition language and reconnects the WebSocket.

methods.name: set_prompt(self, prompt: Optional[str])
methods.description: Sets the translation prompt and reconnects the WebSocket.

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Starts the STT service, establishing WebSocket connection.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops the STT service and disconnects from WebSocket.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Cancels ongoing STT processing and disconnects.

methods.name: run_stt(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Sends audio data to the Sarvam service for transcription, handling encoding and WebSocket communication.

methods.name: _connect(self)
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection using Sarvam SDK, registers event handlers, manages prompts, and prepares for receiving transcriptions.

methods.name: _disconnect(self)
methods.description: Terminates WebSocket connection gracefully, cancelling receive tasks.

methods.name: _receive_task_handler(self)
methods.description: Listens for messages from Sarvam WebSocket and processes incoming data asynchronously.

methods.name: _handle_message(self, message)
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages, handling VAD events, transcriptions, and language detection.

methods.name: _handle_transcription( self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Optional[Language] = None )
methods.description: Processes and traces a transcription result, decorated with @traced_stt for observability.

methods.description: Maps Sarvam language codes to pipecat Language enum.
